item.title: South Carolina man sentenced to 3 life sentences for shooting, killing NMSP officer may face death sentence
item.description: A man who was sentenced to three life sentences in prison in New Mexico has had a Notice of Intent to Seek the Death Penalty filed against him in the U.S. District Court of South Carolina.

item.title: State Board of Education discusses changes to social studies curriculum
item.description: The Texas State Board of Education is considering making Texas history a prominent part of the social studies curriculum, but some educators and students have concerns about the density of the material and the lack of time to revise it.

item.title: Randall High School girls soccer team looking to repeat UIL Class 4A D-II champions
item.description: The Randall High girls' soccer team is rolling this season after a slow start, looking to repeat as the Texas high school UIL Class 4A Division II state champions.

item.title: Howardwick City Secretary became community lifeline during 8 Ball fire
item.description: When the 8 Ball fire burned near Howardwick last week, residents searching for answers turned to a familiar name online.

item.title: 2 arrested in Randall County on drug possession charges

item.title: Crews responding to Wednesday night structure fire in north Amarillo
item.description: The Amarillo Fire Department is responding to a structure fire in north Amarillo on Wednesday night.

item.title: Alleged suspects who shot at NMSP officer arrested
item.description: The suspect who shot a New Mexico State Police Officer earlier this week near Ft. Sumner has been identified.

item.title: Fire warning issued Tuesday after wildfire reported in Beaver County
item.description: The National Weather Service issued a fire warning at around 11:50 a.m. on Tuesday on request by the Oklahoma Forestry Service, after reports of a wildfire three miles northeast of Beaver in Beaver County.

item.title: Wildfires cause evacuations, impact traffic across the Texas Panhandle, Oklahoma, Kansas
item.description: During critically dry and high-wind conditions on Tuesday, multiple wildfires sparked across communities in portions of the Texas Panhandle, Oklahoma and Kansas, causing a range of evacuations, warnings and road closures.
